title: Hearthmere's gates
text:
The town wall is whole again, and its gateways have doors.

🔧 Fixed a missing stretch of Hearthmere's wall south of the east gate, where the new Southlands road had cut through it. Roads can no longer break the town wall
✨ Hearthmere's east and west gateways now have iron-bound oak gates. They swing open on their own when anyone comes within 5 yards and close again behind you
